title: Attention Latent Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.31154v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: During autoregressive decoding, the deeper representations of the previous token have already been computed, yet shallow layers at the current token cannot read them directly because standard self-attention connects positions only at the same depth. We introduce Attention Latent Feedback (ALF), an architecture that allows every sublayer to attend to the outputs of the deeper layers at the previous position. Training unrolls this cross-position recurrence into two parallel passes, whereas decoding remains single-pass using cached previous-token states. Across mixture-of-experts models with up to 4.0B parameters, ALF lowers held-out loss by 0.022-0.024 nats over the standard residual with about 1.1% decoding FLOP overhead, and consistently outperforms prior final-state feedback across all three scales on both standard and attention residual backbones. translated_abstract: 在自回归解码过程中，前一个token的深层表示已经被计算出来，然而当前token的浅层却无法直接读取它们，因为标准的自注意力机制只连接相同深度上的位置。我们提出了注意力潜在反馈（ALF），这是一种允许每个子层关注前一个位置更深层输出的架构。训练时，这种跨位置递归被展开为两次并行传递，而解码时则利用缓存的前一个token状态保持单次传递。在参数量高达4.0B的混合专家（MoE）模型上，ALF相比标准残差结构将留存损失降低了0.022-0.024 nats，解码FLOP开销仅约1.1%，并且在标准残差和注意力残差两种骨干架构上，在所有三个模型规模上都持续优于先前的最终状态反馈方法。在MoE-1.6B上，ALF达到了相当于基线1.38倍token预算的效果，在MoE-4.0B上……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出的ALF架构通过让每一子层关注前一个token位置的深层输出，以仅约1.1%的解码计算开销显著降低语言模型的留存损失，并在多个MoE模型规模上持续超越现有的最终状态反馈方法。
en_tdlr: Attention Latent Feedback (ALF) enables each sublayer to attend to deeper-layer outputs at the previous token position, reducing held-out loss by 0.022-0.024 nats with only ~1.1% decoding FLOP overhead and consistently outperforming prior final-state feedback across multiple MoE model scales.
